items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Anyway, Irving Mills is our manager.

ctx.x: On our way West -- I'm telling it again. Anyway, Irving Mills is our manager. He said, I like that May Alex. So Duke say, "What do you think, Man?" I say, "Man, we look like hell with somebody who looks like a white girl standing in front of our band.
